verdict.rationale: Base44 documents a JS SDK with CRUD entity operations, a CLI for creating/managing apps, and an MCP server (App MCP) letting external AI assistants connect to published apps — solid evidence of programmatic/agentic access. However, probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/REST spec (all candidate paths 404), and a disclosed vulnerability shows undocumented endpoints existed alongside the documented API, undermining confidence in complete/secure API documentation. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/REST specification, and independent confirmation that documented endpoints are complete and don't rely on undocumented internal ones.
